gloss: secret photography; voyeuristic filming; hidden camera recording

definitions.gloss: secret photography; voyeuristic filming; hidden camera recording
definitions.explanation: Taking photos or videos of someone without their knowledge or consent, especially in an invasive or illegal manner. A criminal offense in Japan.

examples.japanese: {盗撮|とうさつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧です。
⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{盗撮|とうさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A man who was secretly filming at the station was arrested.

examples.japanese: {盗撮|とうさつ}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{更衣室|こういしつ}→更衣室：07042_kouishitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧{検知器|けんちき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Camera detectors were installed in the changing rooms to prevent secret filming.

notes:
A compound of {盗|とう} (steal, secret) + {撮|さつ} (photograph, film). Refers to the illegal act of photographing or filming someone without consent, particularly in a sexual or invasive context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盗撮|とうさつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to secretly photograph/film
- {盗撮|とうさつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}される→逮捕する：26830_taihosuru⟧: to be arrested for voyeuristic filming
- {盗撮|とうさつ}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧: prevention of secret filming
- {盗撮|とうさつ}⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: being a victim of voyeuristic filming
- {盗撮|とうさつ}⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧: hidden camera

LEGAL CONTEXT:
In Japan, {盗撮|とうさつ} is punished under various laws, including prefectural nuisance prevention ordinances ({迷惑防止条例|めいわくぼうしじょうれい}). Smartphones in Japan are required to make a shutter sound that cannot be silenced, partly as a deterrent.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{隠|かく}し→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧: hidden camera — the device used for secret filming
- {盗聴|とうちょう}: wiretapping, eavesdropping — the audio equivalent
- ⟦プライバシー→プライバシー：06806_puraibashii⟧⟦{侵害|しんがい}→侵害：11563_shingai⟧: invasion of privacy — the broader legal concept
